title: Battle of Pungo Andongo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Pungo Andongo", at revision 1370586775, opens: "The battle of Pungo Andongo, was a military engagement in what is today Angola between Portugal and the Kingdom of Ndongo whose capital, Pungo Andongo, also known as Pedras Negras, was besieged. After a 9-month long encirclement, the capital was taken by storm, plundered, and occupied by the Portuguese." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q109058273, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1671 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
